LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Render at genuine original native resolution supported by this tool, preferably at least1024pixels long edge. No enlargement or upscaling. a fictional adult white woman with lightly freckled fair skin and hazel eyes, age 48, wearing a loose opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK long-sleeved jumper with very loose fabric covering upper chest completely. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Short bixie haircuts. Design: smooth flat | curved graduated | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 2-crown-to-front-proportion. Attributes: {"texture": "coily", "strand": "medium", "density": "medium", "length": "short", "fringe": "wispy", "colour": "dark", "finish": "natural", "age_reference": "adult", "face_reference": "unspecified", "maintenance": "discuss"}. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
FULL FRAMING: head and shoulder line only, full sharp hair silhouette surrounded by background margin. Loose opaque oversized tall ivory turtleneck, no neckline/chest/shoulder exposure, no body contours. All hair sharp with no deliberate blur.
CUT STRUCTURE: true bob-pixie hybrid with longer ear-level side shape and a distinctly shorter graduated or tapered nape as specified; never a full bob. TEXTURE CRITICAL: small tight densely spiralling corkscrew COILS, pencil-sized ringlets, not loose waves or broad curls.
TEXTURE PRIORITY: natural dark tight spring-shaped COILS with tiny 3-4 mm cylindrical corkscrews from roots to tips, contraction visible; no broad curls or waves. Low smooth flat crown, wispy fringe of a few small coil tips, longer ear-level temple coils and cropped curved graduated nape, compact short bixie hybrid rather than afro or ordinary pixie.
